short_description: Merchants unable to e-sign the Merchant Agreement; onboarding stuck at the document step with a permission error in the UI
description: Merchants could not e-sign the Merchant Agreement and onboarding was stuck at the document step with a permission error in the UI. onboarding-api returned HTTP 403 permission_denied. Treated as a stale permission cache after a role change; affected new-merchant signups in us-east-1.
resolution: Restarted onboarding-api pods and invalidated the merchant permission cache; the e-sign step recovered. Closed as an onboarding-api permission-cache issue.

short_description: Onboarding e-sign failures traced to user-db read-replica lag after failover
description: Merchants hit permission and 'merchant not found' errors at the onboarding e-sign step. onboarding-api and merchant-service looked healthy in isolation. The real cause was user-db read-replica lag following a primary failover; merchant-service was serving stale reads two hops downstream of the alert.
resolution: Routed merchant-service critical reads to the user-db primary until the replica caught up, then reverted. Restarting onboarding-api had no effect; the fix was at user-db, not the onboarding tier.

short_description: Auth login failures and stale reads during user-db replica failover
description: auth-service login latency above SLO and intermittent 'user not found' immediately after writes. Correlated with a user-db read-replica failover event. Each downstream service looked fine on its own dashboard.
resolution: Routed auth reads to the user-db primary until replica lag drained below 5s, then failed back. Restarting auth-service did not resolve it; the problem was the shared user-db replica.

short_description: Cascading permission errors across onboarding and auth from user-db lag
description: A user-db replica fell behind after a failover; both onboarding-api (via merchant-service) and auth-service surfaced permission and stale-read errors at the same time. Front-line restarts of the leaf services were attempted first and failed.
resolution: Promoted a healthy user-db replica and routed reads to the primary; lag cleared and the downstream errors stopped. Confirmed the leaf-service restarts were a red herring; the shared upstream dependency was the root cause.

short_description: user-db connection pool exhausted during traffic spike
description: user-db hit max connections during a morning traffic spike; auth-service and merchant-service saw timeouts and 'too many connections' errors. Downstream services appeared slow but were not the cause.
resolution: Raised the user-db connection pool limit and added pgbouncer pooling; downstream timeouts cleared. The leaf services needed no change.

short_description: Slow analytical query on user-db primary stalled replication
description: A heavy ad-hoc analytical query on the user-db primary pushed replication lag past 10s. auth and merchant reads went stale. Metrics on the consuming services looked nominal in isolation.
resolution: Killed the long-running query and added the missing index; replica lag drained and stale reads stopped.

short_description: user-db lock contention after bulk merchant import
description: A bulk merchant-import job held locks on user-db, blocking reads for onboarding and auth. The symptom surfaced as permission errors in onboarding-api.
resolution: Throttled the import job and let replicas apply; lock contention cleared and onboarding recovered. Restarting onboarding-api was a red herring.

short_description: Stale reads after user-db failover affected merchant lookups
description: After an unplanned user-db primary failover, read replicas briefly served stale data. merchant-service returned 'merchant not found' for newly created accounts.
resolution: Routed critical merchant reads to the primary until the replica caught up, then reverted.

short_description: user-db replica lag caused intermittent auth timeouts
description: auth-service login p99 climbed and some sessions failed to refresh. Correlated with rising user_db_replica_lag_seconds after a maintenance failover.
resolution: Failed reads over to the primary until lag fell below 5s, then failed back once replicas caught up.

short_description: Write burst outpaced user-db replica apply
description: A sign-up campaign produced a write burst that outpaced replica apply on user-db; downstream reads were inconsistent for several minutes.
resolution: Throttled the campaign writes and let replicas catch up; consistency restored without touching the leaf services.

short_description: payment-gateway processor timeouts spiked card declines
description: payment-gateway saw processor timeouts and card declines above 6%. The upstream card processor was slow to respond; settlement reconciliation fell behind.
resolution: Failed over to the secondary processor route and increased the processor timeout budget; declines returned to baseline.

short_description: Settlement reconciliation lag at payment-gateway
description: payment-gateway settlement batch fell behind after a processor-side slowdown; reconciliation reports were delayed and declines ticked up.
resolution: Reran the settlement batch against the healthy processor and scaled the reconciliation workers.

short_description: 3DS authentication failures at payment-gateway
description: payment-gateway 3-D Secure step failed intermittently; customers saw declined payments at checkout. The 3DS provider connection was resetting.
resolution: Pinned the 3DS provider connection pool and added retry with backoff; authentication success recovered.

short_description: payment-gateway connection resets to card processor
description: Frequent TCP resets between payment-gateway and the card processor caused transaction retries and elevated latency.
resolution: Rotated the processor connection pool and enabled keep-alive; resets stopped and latency normalized.

short_description: Elevated decline rate from payment-gateway risk rules
description: A mis-tuned risk rule in payment-gateway rejected legitimate transactions, spiking the decline rate in eu-west-1.
resolution: Reverted the risk-rule change and allow-listed the affected BINs; declines returned to normal.

short_description: network-gateway egress saturation caused outbound timeouts
description: network-gateway egress bandwidth approached its ceiling; multiple services reported outbound timeouts to external endpoints.
resolution: Shifted egress to a second NAT path and raised the bandwidth ceiling; outbound timeouts cleared.

short_description: DNS resolution failures at network-gateway
description: network-gateway intermittently failed to resolve external hostnames; dependent services saw connection errors to third-party APIs.
resolution: Restarted the resolver and added a secondary DNS upstream with caching; resolution stabilized.

short_description: TLS handshake errors through network-gateway
description: Outbound TLS handshakes through network-gateway failed after a cipher change at an external endpoint; services saw handshake timeouts.
resolution: Updated the egress TLS profile and cipher suite; handshakes succeeded again.

short_description: network-gateway connection pool exhaustion to external APIs
description: The outbound connection pool at network-gateway was exhausted during peak, causing queueing and timeouts for several services.
resolution: Increased the outbound pool size and added circuit breaking for the slow endpoint.

short_description: Packet loss on network-gateway uplink
description: An uplink on network-gateway showed packet loss, inflating latency and causing intermittent outbound timeouts.
resolution: Drained the degraded uplink and rerouted traffic to the healthy link; latency recovered.

short_description: document-service render workers saturated, e-sign 502s
description: A burst of new merchants saturated the document-service PDF render pool; envelope generation latency passed 2s and onboarding-api saw 502s at the e-sign step.
resolution: Scaled the render workers and shed retries; envelope latency returned under 500ms.

short_description: Template cache cold-start slowed document-service after deploy
description: A deploy invalidated the agreement-template cache in document-service; the first wave of e-sign requests paid a cold render cost and timed out.
resolution: Warmed the template cache and staggered the rollout; latency normalized.

short_description: document-service memory pressure caused render OOM
description: document-service render workers hit memory limits generating large PDFs, causing OOM restarts and failed envelopes.
resolution: Raised the worker memory limit and capped concurrent renders; OOMs stopped.

short_description: PDF generation timeouts at document-service
description: Envelope generation in document-service timed out under load; onboarding e-sign step failed intermittently for new merchants.
resolution: Added a render queue with backpressure and scaled workers; timeouts cleared.

short_description: document-service 5xx from a bad template deploy
description: A malformed agreement template deploy caused document-service to return 5xx on envelope generation.
resolution: Rolled back the template and added a validation check to the deploy pipeline.

short_description: merchant-service served stale fields after config update
description: A config update left merchant-service serving stale merchant fields in the onboarding UI; data looked outdated but services were up.
resolution: Invalidated the merchant-service config cache and redeployed the correct config; fields refreshed.

short_description: merchant-service cache inconsistency after partial deploy
description: A partial deploy left merchant-service cache nodes inconsistent; some requests returned old merchant records.
resolution: Flushed the merchant-service cache and completed the rollout to all nodes.

short_description: merchant-service p99 latency breach under load
description: merchant-service p99 latency breached SLO during peak onboarding; upstream onboarding-api slowed as a result.
resolution: Scaled merchant-service replicas and tuned the DB connection pool; p99 returned within SLO.

short_description: merchant-service read failures from merchant-db contention
description: merchant-service reads failed intermittently due to lock contention in merchant-db; onboarding showed missing merchant data.
resolution: Resolved the merchant-db contention and retried; merchant-service reads recovered.

short_description: Bad feature flag broke merchant-service serialization
description: A feature flag change caused merchant-service to drop fields during serialization, showing incomplete records in the UI.
resolution: Disabled the flag and redeployed; records rendered completely again.

short_description: auth-service login latency above SLO on mobile
description: auth-service login latency exceeded the 1s SLO with intermittent session-refresh failures on mobile clients.
resolution: Scaled auth-service and fixed a slow token-validation path; latency returned under SLO.

short_description: Session refresh failures at auth-service after deploy
description: A deploy changed token TTL handling in auth-service, causing sessions to fail refresh and users to be logged out.
resolution: Rolled back the TTL change and invalidated affected sessions gracefully.

short_description: auth-service token validation errors from key rotation
description: A key rotation was not fully propagated, so auth-service rejected valid tokens signed with the previous key.
resolution: Completed key propagation and allowed both keys during the overlap window.

short_description: MFA step failing intermittently at auth-service
description: auth-service multi-factor step failed intermittently when the OTP provider was slow, blocking logins.
resolution: Added retry and a fallback OTP channel; MFA success recovered.

short_description: auth-service stale permission reads after role change
description: auth-service served stale permissions after a role change because the permission cache did not invalidate.
resolution: Invalidated the permission cache entry; correct permissions applied immediately (TTL would have cleared in 15m).

short_description: onboarding-api stale permission cache blocked e-sign
description: onboarding-api returned 403 permission_denied at the e-sign step after a role change; the local permission cache was stale.
resolution: Invalidated the merchant permission cache entry; the e-sign step recovered immediately.

short_description: onboarding-api upstream timeout from document-service
description: onboarding-api timed out at the document step because document-service was slow; onboarding itself was healthy.
resolution: Followed the document-service runbook (scaled render workers); onboarding recovered once document-service did.

short_description: onboarding-api 403s from a bad RBAC deploy
description: A role-mapping deploy caused onboarding-api to deny valid merchants with 403 at the document step.
resolution: Rolled back the RBAC change and cleared the permission cache.

short_description: onboarding-api document-step failures during campaign
description: A sign-up campaign spiked onboarding volume; the document step failed for a subset of merchants under load.
resolution: Scaled onboarding-api and the document render pool; failures cleared.

short_description: api-gateway 5xx spike on onboarding and auth routes
description: api-gateway returned elevated 5xx to web clients, concentrated on routes to onboarding-api and auth-service; the deeper cause was a shared user-db dependency.
resolution: Traced the 5xx to user-db replica lag and remediated there; api-gateway errors cleared without gateway changes.

short_description: api-gateway routing errors after config reload
description: A bad route-config reload in api-gateway sent some requests to the wrong upstream, producing 404s and 502s.
resolution: Reverted the route config and reloaded; routing recovered.

short_description: notification-service email delivery delays
description: notification-service email delivery backed up after the SMTP provider throttled; onboarding confirmation emails were delayed.
resolution: Switched to the backup SMTP relay and drained the queue; delivery caught up.

short_description: merchant-db lock contention slowed merchant-service
description: Long-held locks in merchant-db slowed merchant-service reads, surfacing as sluggish onboarding lookups.
resolution: Identified and killed the blocking transaction; locks cleared and reads sped up.

short_description: web-portal asset load failures after CDN purge
description: web-portal static assets failed to load after a CDN purge, breaking parts of the onboarding UI until the cache repopulated.
resolution: Repopulated the CDN cache and added a warmup step to future purges.

short_description: Merchants unable to e-sign the Merchant Agreement; permission error at the document step
description: Merchants could not e-sign the Merchant Agreement and onboarding stalled at the document step with a permission error in the UI. onboarding-api and merchant-service were healthy on their own dashboards. The real cause was user-db read-replica lag after a primary failover, so merchant permission reads were stale two hops downstream.
resolution: Routed merchant reads to the user-db primary until the replica caught up, then reverted; the e-sign step recovered. Restarting onboarding-api did nothing, the fix was at user-db.

short_description: Onboarding stuck at the document step with permission errors for new merchants
description: New-merchant onboarding was stuck at the document e-sign step with HTTP 403 permission errors in the UI. Direct services looked nominal. Correlated with a user-db read-replica failover event that made permission lookups return stale or denied results.
resolution: Failed user-db reads over to the primary until replica lag drained below 5s; permission checks succeeded and e-sign recovered.

short_description: Merchant e-sign blocked by permission error; traced to user-db replica lag
description: Merchants hit a permission error at the document e-sign step during onboarding. onboarding-api was healthy; the shared user-db replica was lagging after a failover, so auth and merchant permission reads were stale.
resolution: Promoted a healthy user-db replica and routed critical reads to the primary; lag cleared and the e-sign permission errors stopped.
